description: Inspect stored US government macro observations: Treasury yields and curve spreads, industrial production, trade-weighted dollar, initial claims, inflation, payrolls, retail sales, GDP, PCE and Fed liquidity components. Returns per-series units and observation dates. No proprietary volatility, credit spreads, consumer surveys, stock breadth or AlphaYou regime score. Not live economic releases or a forecast.
name: get_macro_context
title: Read US macro context
